units: object keyed by decimal unit ID; omit fully withheld units

unit_fields.generations: array of flattened clamps.target and clamps.random_controls rows
unit_fields.agreement: unchanged F1b agreement array, counts and rates only
unit_fields.top_context_token_ids: source agreement set after M5 card-token scrub, IDs only
unit_fields.baseline_summary: greedy and seeded total/different/same/withheld counts from stored flags

generation_fields.direction_id: 0/1 for random control; null for target
generation_fields.token_ids: original IDs only on nonwithheld rows; absent when withheld
generation_fields.text: filtered generated text; absent when withheld
generation_fields.same_as_baseline: boolean token-ID equality with same-start/seed baseline; null if either row is withheld
generation_fields.token_pieces: aligned decoded pieces; EOG empty; scrubbed piece null; absent when withheld; mark only when exact text reconstruction

unclamped: top-level array; filtered 12 shared baseline rows; not inferred
missing: 404 or missing unit means not tried; no absent-file caching
failure: non404 fetch/parse/filter-state error offers retry; never treated as a result
